method: Read-only control-flow review of current source; no new native-host test execution and no repeat of assignment16 identity matrix.

findings.result: Serializes APVTS parameter snapshot; normaliseRestoredState completes snapshot from schema defaults; replaceState restores it directly. setPresetMetadata only clamps/display-publishes factoryIndex and clears pending MIDI identity. No factory recall occurs.
Schema-specific parameter defaults are used, never a factory record or the fresh instance values. Engine fallback remains Legacy before schema3 and Circuit from schema3.
Fresh startup explicitly selects Circuit0/host222 Brass Swell I; this patch is outside the twelve refinements. Later valid session state replaces all restored parameters.

User save writes actual APVTS sound values. User load restores values directly and identity metadata separately; it deliberately retains existing live Pure, oversampling, output-jack and tuning-mode settings. None of this behavior changed.
Snapshots store actual parameter values, modern configuration, hardware sources and memory values. Recall applies snapshot values, not current factory values; restored factory index is metadata only.

Explicit setCurrentProgram or permitted MIDI Program Change selects current bank values at unchanged addresses. Program-number-only project restore, or a later program event, intentionally loads revised timbre.

Existing compatibility wording correctly distinguishes serialized values from explicit factory recall. Parent publication pass should refresh displayed revision to2026.11.1 and retain program-number caveat.

limitations: No new claim of bit-identical audio across arbitrary oscillator/controller histories or DAWs. This review establishes unchanged restore control flow, not a fresh native-host run.
